items.title: Monitoring variable values with watch expressions

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Monitoring variable values with watch expressions as printed (PDF 66, printed 62); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the Using Breakpoints and Watches lesson.

blocks.text: Watch expressions track the values of variables while the program is running. They update automatically when variable values change. This helps identify incorrect or unexpected data during execution. Watches allow observing how data changes step by step in real time.
